name: Google Docs
description: Read, create, and edit Google Docs with professional formatting and branding. Create beautifully branded docs from structured JSON content (docs-create-branded) or HTML (docs-create --from-html). Edits are surgical and in-place by default. Rich styling via docs-style (font, size, color, spacing, shading). Auto-enrichment: the skill adds professional formatting even when the request is sparse. A docx round-trip is reserved for wholesale rebuilds.
summary: Work with Google Docs — create professionally branded documents from structured content, surgically edit in place (formatting preserved), apply rich styling, auto-enrich sparse requests with professional formatting, verify with fingerprints.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When a task involves reading, creating, editing, or finalizing a Google Doc, or leaving review comments on one.
